name: cache_input_unreported
description: An adapter that reports cache_read on every call and never reports input. The cache hit ratio is cache_read / (cache_read + input), and half of that expression was never observed, so the share is unknown and cache_hit_ratio must report unavailable. It must not report 1.0: an unobserved input side is not zero fresh tokens, and treating it as zero makes the ratio come out at a perfect 1.0, which would let an adapter that cannot see fresh input at all outscore one that reports both honestly. This is the mirror of interleaved_loops, which reports input without cache_read; absence on either side leaves the share unknown.
